title: I Still Dream of Taking First!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While we're training for the Japanese Derby, Rice Shower tells Matikanetannhauser about her admiration for Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, several reporters arrive at the academy to interview Mihono Bourbon. Among them is a dejected-looking reporter in round glasses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reporters seem to think Mihono Bourbon is the only Umamusume who has a chance of winning. They tell Matikanetannhauser that no one is interested in reading about anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser tells them, "I know there's nothing special about me, but if it's not first place, I don't need it!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She speaks passionately, and her words seem to have struck a chord with the gloomy reporter in the round glasses.
